name: The DCI Celebration Countdown Cinema Event

jsonData.name: The DCI Celebration Countdown Cinema Event
jsonData.notesIndividualTickets: Tickets are available at over 700 cinemas in the United States. Prices vary by location. We regret that international viewing will be unavailable due to audio rights.
jsonData.notesGeneral:
Following a one-year hiatus, this special one-night event features amazing sights and sounds from five of the nation’s top Drum Corps International ensembles, including iconic DCI World Championship performances from Fort Mill, SC’s Carolina Crown’s Inferno (2015); Rosemont, IL’s The Cavaliers’ Propaganda (2016), Concord, CA’s Blue Devils’ Metamorph (2017); Santa Clara, CA’s Santa Clara Vanguard’s (2018) Babylon; and Canton, OH’s Bluecoats The Bluecoats 2019). 

Additionally, interspersed between the performances, attendees will see live spots with broadcast hosts from the spring training site of the Bluecoats, in addition to pre-recorded up-to-the-moment rehearsal camp updates from several other groups that will appear at DCI events this August at Indianapolis’ Lucas Oil Stadium.
jsonData.groupTicketsDisclaimer: Group tickets are not available for this event.
jsonData.eventName: The DCI Celebration Countdown Cinema Event

jsonData.name: DCI Celebration Fan Cut Outs
jsonData.notesIndividualTickets: Order your cutout online by July 19 at https://www.flipcause.com/secure/cause_pdetails/MTEzMzc5
jsonData.notesGeneral:
After a year off and in the wake of the cancelation of the 2020 DCI Tour, Drum Corps International is set to return to Indianapolis' Lucas Oil Stadium August 12–14. Nearly two dozen corps will have the unique opportunity to showcase their performances – perhaps unlike at any other time in DCI history!

You can take part in the celebration, even if you can’t join us in-person at Lucas Oil Stadium this August! For a donation of $100 to DCI’s ongoing programs, your supplied photographic image will be reproduced as a life-size DCI Fan Cut Out that will be placed in Lucas Oil Stadium during DCI's Celebration Events. This is a unique and unprecedented opportunity for loyal fans, family, and even cherished pets to be “in the audience” for this once in a lifetime three-day event!
